title: [spec-gap][R-12-057] SOS dispatch byte 0x16: no emitter anywhere; Rust rejects it
description: spec/12-apps.md:852-858 (18.4.3, REQUIRED): sender MUST emit SOS with link-layer dispatch byte 0x16 carrying the 18.4.2 CBOR alert map, NOT as SCHC-compressed CoAP; relays classify solely by this byte. Evidence: no sender in C/Python/Rust emits 0x16; C classifies but no consumer (l2_payload.h:34, lichen_link_rx.c:327); Python classifies only (constants.py:44, l2_payload.py:40, node.py:923); Rust lichen-core/src/l2_payload.rs:83 test asserts classify_known(&[0x16]) == Err(UnknownDispatch) — direct conflict with spec 02-physical-link.md:237-244, C, and Python. Consequence: 18.4.3 rebroadcast-once and the 3/hour SOS budget cannot work. Placement: rust/lichen-core l2_payload SOS variant + TX emission paths in all stacks.
close_reason: SOS dispatch 0x16 classification landed in all three stacks + canonical vectors. Rust: lichen-core L2_DISPATCH_SOS=0x16, L2PayloadKind::Sos, wrap_sos_payload, classify; lichen-link shared_vectors sos arm. Python: L2_DISPATCH_SOS, L2PayloadKind.SOS, wrap_sos_payload, classify; test_l2_payload + test_vectors kind maps. C: LICHEN_L2_DISPATCH_SOS, LICHEN_L2_PAYLOAD_SOS, classify; l2_dispatch tests (SOS classify + short fail-closed; reserved probe bumped 0x16->0x17). constants.toml [l2.payload_dispatch] sos=0x16. Vectors: reserved_0x16 (stale, claimed 0x16 unassigned) replaced by sos_alert_dispatch + malformed_sos_dispatch_only; schema kind enum +sos; docs/spec-coverage R-02-043 updated. Verified: Rust l2_payload 5/5 + shared_vectors 4/4, Python l2_payload 272/272, C syntax OK, toml parses. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge, kimi-k3): correctness found shared_vectors missing sos arm (fixed inline, filed P3) + P4 ledger row (fixed inline); security PASS (dispatch byte inside signed payload, no spoofing surface; C/Python parity confirmed); edge PASS (single-octet fail-closed all stacks, reserved 0x17, no exhaustive-match breakage — all consumers use != comparisons). Emission (no stack emits 0x16 yet) filed as separate P2 bead. NOTE: lichen-node build is pre-broken by an unrelated bad merge in rpl_stack/mod.rs (filed P0 separately); lichen-link default-feature test build break also filed separately (P2).
